code:
SELECT d.equality_columns, d.included_columns,
       s.avg_user_impact, s.user_seeks + s.user_scans AS times_helpful
FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_details d
JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups g ON d.index_handle = g.index_handle
JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats s ON g.index_group_handle = s.group_handle
ORDER BY s.avg_user_impact DESC;
caption: The optimizer's own wish list -- treat avg_user_impact as a hint, then verify.

code:
SELECT t.name, i.name, c.name AS leading_column
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id
  AND ic.index_id = i.index_id AND ic.key_ordinal = 1
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = i.object_id
ORDER BY t.name, c.name;
caption: Same table + leading column appearing twice? Duplicate candidate.

code:
SELECT t.name, i.name, s.user_seeks, s.user_scans,
       s.user_lookups, s.user_updates
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = i.object_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats s
  ON s.object_id = i.object_id AND s.index_id = i.index_id
WHERE ISNULL(s.user_seeks,0)=0 AND ISNULL(s.user_scans,0)=0
  AND ISNULL(s.user_lookups,0)=0;
caption: Zero seeks/scans/lookups but real writes -- pure overhead, zero benefit.

subtitle: SQL Server's own flight data recorder for query plans.
